description: AI-powered services and software solutions designed for insurance brokers.
overview: Anzen is an AI-enabled insurance distribution platform that materially improves the workflow within a broker's office from basic email ingestion to quoting and policy placement, management, and renewal.

description: Offers a digital cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) platform addressing insomnia, generalized anxiety disorder (GAD), and depression.
overview: Big Health has built a digital cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) platform addressing insomnia, generalized anxiety disorder (GAD), and depression. The company has established one of the most robust clinical evidence bases in digital therapeutics, with over 100 peer-reviewed publications and 26 randomized controlled trials demonstrating sustained outcomes at 6, 12, and 36-month follow-up across large patient cohorts. Big Health’s FDA-cleared prescription digital therapeutics (SleepioRx for insomnia and DaylightRx for anxiety) enable providers to deliver immediate access to first-line, evidence-based behavioral care at scale.

description: Independent verification for all clinical orders
overview: Cirtiq is building an AI-enabled safety layer for clinical decision-making and AI governance. The Company’s platform reviews every clinical order before it reaches the patient, validating it against the full clinical record and either approving it or flagging it for human review. While largely invisible in routine care, OrderGuard is designed to intercept high-severity errors, preventing dangerous, costly, and avoidable adverse events. Physicians placing orders today typically rely on data in their local EHR, which can be incomplete, outdated, and siloed from records at other institutions. The Company aggregates and reconciles patient information across health information exchanges (HIEs) to create a single, accurate longitudinal patient record that functions as the source of truth.

description: Integrates data from a variety of sources to enable better decision-making on individuals and small businesses.
overview: Confianza provides insurance brokers, carriers, and related financial service companies with a variety of proprietary, licensed, and public data services to drive actionable insights related to individuals, households, and approximately 60 million small businesses, including artisans and sole proprietors. The company's solutions are relevant to both pre-bind and post-bind workflows.

description: Automates P&C medical bills from intake through final payment.
overview: Data Dimensions is an established business process automator (BPA) that uses the latest digital technologies in innovative ways. The company provides digital capabilities at scale to help insurers streamline core workflows to reduce policy administration and claims-handling expenses.

description: Cloud-native data catalog solution for large enterprises.
overview: data.world developed a cloud-native data catalog that makes it easier for data scientists, actuaries, and analysts to get clear, accurate, and faster answers to business questions. The company's knowledge graph architecture enables users to find and classify data, map data lineage, and track data changes.

description: Provides digital marketing solutions to measure customer intent and complete transactions.
overview: The Embedded Company (TEC) has built a platform to measure consumer intent and to serve buying opportunities across a variety of sectors and platforms. To create its offering, TEC acquired the assets of REIN (a Sandbox portfolio company).

description: Developer of an AI-powered claims and underwriting analytics platform.
overview: Gradient AI provides AI-powered underwriting and claims solutions for insurers. Its SaaS platform draws on an industry data lake of tens of millions of policies and claims to help carriers, MGAs, TPAs, risk pools, PEOs, and large self-insured employers predict risk more accurately, automate underwriting, and improve profitability.

description: AI-enabled prior authorization automation software platform for providers and payors.
overview: Humata Health has developed an AI-enabled prior authorization workflow for providers and payers. The platform supports referral automation, authorization status & determination, medical necessity policies, clinical bundling, direct submit, authorization statusing, post-authorization monitoring, analytics/audit, and continuous improvement. The Company supports PA workflows for both providers and payers within all medical categories as well as specialty pharmaceuticals.

description: AI-powered platform automating the intake, enrichment, and orchestration of structured and unstructured data.
overview: Indico uses transfer learning methodology to help enterprises more effectively ingest structured, semi-structured, and unstructured content by automating the identification and extraction process based on minimal document samples in an intuitive platform.

description: Technology-enabled subrogation and claims recovery for health plans and self-funded employers.
overview: Intellivo provides technology-enabled subrogation and claims recovery services to health plans, TPAs, and self-funded employers. The Company’s proprietary platform analyzes claims data to identify third-party reimbursement opportunities, including previously missed recoveries, and manages the end-to-end recovery process from case identification and documentation through investigation, negotiation, and collection.

description: Developer of an AI-driven platform to enable insurance brokers to streamline the handling of small commercial policies.
overview: Layr connects small businesses to a variety of carriers to find the best coverage for their needs and to bind and renew coverage. The application workflow is intuitive, streamlined, and offers education and guidance to help the policyholder make informed purchasing decisions.

description: Offers a non-invasive, drug-free device used in the treatment of restless leg syndrome (RLS).
overview: Noctrix Health has developed a non-invasive neurostimulation device for the treatment of restless leg syndrome (RLS). The Company’s product, Nidra, is a wearable, drug-free therapy that stimulates the peroneal nerves in the legs bilaterally for 30 minutes daily to relieve RLS symptoms. The product works by using electrical stimulation to tonically activate the muscles in the legs, sending a signal to the brain that prevents activation of the leg muscles in the way that is characteristic of RLS.

description: Developing minimally-invasive diagnostics solution for gynecological cancers.
overview: PinkDx is focused on improving the diagnostic outcome for women who have vague symptoms that could signal a gynecological cancer. Each year in the United States, an estimated 1.5 million women present with general symptoms, including bloating, pelvic pain, and abnormal bleeding, for which the cause is not clear. Over 100,000 women in the U.S. are ultimately diagnosed with a gynecological cancer each year. PinkDx is developing solutions to replace invasive, painful diagnostic procedures and mitigate the significant delays women and their doctors often face in obtaining answers.

description: Digital identity management solutions to reduce fraud and friction.
overview: Prove provides modern digital identity solutions that leverage consumers’ phone numbers as their key digital fingerprint. Prove's omni-channel platform enables frictionless consumer engagement across digital portals, mobile apps, and call centers, while improving the security of transactions. In addition to verification and authentication, Prove's platform also supports outbound engagement by tracking and continually updating those phone numbers as and when they are changed.

description: Marketing software solution for the Marine, Powersports, and RV industries.
overview: Rollick provides marketing, data and technology services to the ecosystem of dealers, manufacturers, and affinity partners that serve the Marine, Powersports and RV industries. Rollick's technology and marketplace solutions help to provide a seamless sales experience for customers and can facilitate the distribution of embedded insurance products at the point of sale.

description: Marketplace solution that matches small businesses with the best lending sources.
overview: Based in the UK, Swoop is a financial services provider for small commercial businesses. Through data integrations with the leading accounting software companies that serve small businesses, Swoop provides small businesses with a single app that connects them to appropriate sources for funding and related financial products, including insurance. The Swoop app also provides the lenders with a complete view of the borrower and an API link for real-time updates based on verified data.

description: AI-powered verification of B2B and B2C payments to reduce fraud.
overview: Verituity provides B2B and B2C payment solutions for enterprises. Its verified digital payout platform leverages proprietary data sourcing and AI-driven decisioning to verify every aspect of a payment transaction, driving operational efficiency and regulatory compliance.
